key_points.text: My guest this week are Kevin Sistram and Mike Krieger, the co-founders of Instagram.

thesis: The speakers discuss their transition to learning machine learning and data pipelines after leaving Instagram, emphasizing that machine learning is fundamentally math rather than magic. They argue that applying this math to new problems requires a healthy dose of humility and a reasonable hypothesis about why adding data will yield useful predictions.
